title: Fill Us Up and Send Us Out
lyrics: [C]Have you not said as we [G]pass though water,
[C]And you have said when we [G]walk though fire,
[C]We are not afraid, for [G]You are with us;
[G]Fill us up and send us out in the [C]power of Your [G]name
[G]Fill us up and send us out in the [C]power [D]of Your [G]name
Bring them from the west, sons and daughters,
Gather from the east all Your children,
Bring them from afar, all the nations,
